acceptance_checks: Build, check, and test capture manifests prove dist regeneration and 137 passing tests for the updated command surfaces.
Validation evidence artifacts show source-backed and bin-backed CLI paths agree on the task-source output contract.
constraints: Validation must use the artifact-loop package root.
Do not rely on unstaged unrelated repo changes.
Close only when bin-backed and source-backed tests agree.

definition_of_done.behavior_outcome: Validation evidence proves the updated CLI contract in both source-backed and dist-backed execution paths.
definition_of_done.rollback_or_fallback: Rebuild dist or revert bounded output changes if validation fails.
definition_of_done.verifier_acceptance_condition: Reviewer confirms the executable bin entrypoint and source tests report the same task-source contract.

failure_signals: emit-test-run.test.ts still reports the old output contract.
Typecheck or full test suite fails after output-string changes.
fallback_or_rollback: Restore dist/source parity by rebuilding or reverting the bounded output change set.
primary_behavior: Verify source, dist, and CLI contract parity with build, typecheck, and full test evidence.
verifier_mapping: Captured build, check, test, and smoke manifests plus reviewer confirmation that the bin entrypoint is updated.
